prompts.landscape_far: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE seamless horizontally repeating distant landscape background for a cozy post-apocalyptic train gardening game on a 480x480 display. Reference is style guidance only: match soft gouache, fine hand-drawn outlines, hazy mint green forests, warm sunlight, cyan sky of the train concept. Wide landscape panorama about 2:1. Sky fills upper half, distant rolling blue-green hills and a few gentle abandoned railway arches reclaimed by nature fill lower half. Calm readable broad silhouettes, not detailed visual noise. Left and right edges must match in color, horizon height and vegetation for horizontal looping. No foreground close-up plants, no train, windows, robot, people, animals, UI, text, frame, watermark. Opaque full canvas, no transparent regions. This is the far parallax layer viewed through train windows.
prompts.robot_atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS, NOT a design presentation. Reference image is the sole robot identity reference. True transparent background. Portrait canvas, exactly FOUR equal-width columns and SIX equal-height rows, 24 individual frames, no gutters drawn, no text, no grid lines. Each frame occupies its own equal rectangular cell with generous empty alpha padding; no sprite crosses cells. Same camera, same robot scale, same baseline in every cell. Robot fills about 70% cell width and 78% height.
Identity locked: small weathered orange-and-ivory rounded cube plant robot, large black oval face panel with two cyan glowing eyes, orange circular side ear joints, glass terrarium dome containing one green sprout with two prominent leaves, dark mechanical underbody, THREE short cream armored articulated tripod legs. No humanoid body, no apron, no backpack, no human arms. Simplified gouache shapes, dark clear outlines, warm highlights, readable at 64px.
Row1 idle: front-three-quarter facing right, neutral eyes, slight down/up breathing, blink, return neutral.
Row2 walking right: four consecutive tripod walking phases, same head orientation and scale, alternating foot lift and contact, no ground scenery.
Row3 tending/harvesting: four phases lean down towards the right, extend small side mechanical gripper with a tiny trowel, gather a green leaf, return upright. No plant or ground baked in.
Row4 watering right: four phases lift small blue watering can with side gripper, tilt can, hold pour pose, lower can. NO stream or detached drops baked in, water is separate asset.
Row5 rest: four phases seated low with legs tucked, calm eyes, sleepy closed eyes, calm eyes. Keep head sprout and exact orange/cream body consistent.
Row6 communication: four phases look towards player, eyes brighten, small side gripper waves, happy crescent eyes. No speech bubble or particles.
NO captions, Chinese, Latin letters, logos, numbers, floor, cast shadow scene, checkerboard texture, watercolor paper background. Every pixel outside robot/tool must be transparent. Fixed cell alignment is essential.
prompts.landscape_near: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one wide horizontally looping NEAR-PARALLAX VEGETATION strip, transparent background. Reference image provides hand-painted cozy reclaimed railway palette and linework only. Wide 2:1 canvas. A continuous low band of olive, sage and pale green bushes, grasses and small saplings across bottom 40% of image; upper 60% must be fully transparent. A few small saplings reach to mid-height, avoiding large focal trees. Soft warm daylight, gouache watercolor masses, restrained ink contours; broad simple silhouettes readable at 480px. Match vegetation height/color at left and right edge to support looping; no protruding isolated edge object. No sky, mountains, train, pots, characters, ground slab, UI, lettering, frame, watermark or painted checkerboard. This strip sits over the distant landscape and behind transparent train windows.
prompts.plants_atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production botanical SPRITE ATLAS for a cozy reclaimed-train gardening game, true transparent background. Reference image only sets warm hand-painted gouache/ink style and palette. Square canvas, EXACTLY THREE columns and THREE rows of equal square cells. Nine separate plant sprites, aligned bottom-center in each cell, alpha padding at least 12% on all sides. No cells drawn, no text, no labels, no ground, soil or pots. Each row is ONE species in three increasing growth stages left to right. Keep identity and stem base position consistent within a row. Simplify fine details for display at 56-72px.
ROW1 TRACKLIGHT FLOWER: left tiny upright two-leaf sprout; middle taller green stem with closed lantern-like flower bud; right one clearly recognizable warm golden five-point star/lantern flower with a luminous pale center, two side leaves. Warm gold resource plant.
ROW2 DEW-NEST MOSS: left tiny soft blue-green low moss tuft; middle larger rounded nest-shaped moss rosette; right mature broad low moss cushion cupping ONE large unmistakable clear pale cyan dew droplet. Low and wide silhouette, not a tall flower. Droplet can be replaced in engine.
ROW3 PATCH-ARMOR VINE: left tiny curled sprout; middle winding vine with three elongated segmented leaves; right robust curving vine with long ribbon-like braided pale fiber strands and segmented green leaves, distinct from flower and moss. Keep same broad lineage.
Dark organic outlines, orange-brown subtle accents, muted sage green leaves, soft daylight from upper left, limited clean shapes, no excessive thin stems. Nine sprites only. No decorative particles, typography, numbers, backgrounds, grid lines, checkerboard texture, watermark. All empty space truly transparent.
prompts.plants_atlas_dry: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied 3x3 botanical game sprite atlas. Make EXACTLY ONE change: in row 2 column 3, remove the large shiny cyan water droplet from the mature moss nest, replacing it with a shallow dark moss-lined empty concavity that matches the existing plant. This is essential: the droplet is a separate moving game object. Keep every other pixel, all nine plant positions, each plant's scale, color, outline, and the exact 3x3 layout unchanged. Preserve the genuinely transparent background and original image dimensions. No new objects, text, borders, shadows, or painted background. The mature moss should remain recognizable as a cupped nest waiting to cradle a separate droplet.
prompts.tree_atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: TWO-STAGE TREE GAME SPRITE ATLAS. Reference: supplied cozy hand-painted train scene style only. Wide canvas, exactly TWO equal square cells left and right, transparent background. Bottom-center trunk anchor at the same height in both cells. At least 8% empty padding; nothing crosses center boundary.
LEFT: a small hopeful young tree, slender warm brown trunk, a few small branches with 7-10 fresh yellow-green leaves, modest crown, occupies lower half of its cell.
RIGHT: same tree after growth, thicker gently curved trunk, generous rounded leafy green canopy with distinct sunlit clusters, warm golden rim light, broad roots, space beneath canopy where a small robot could rest. Large canopy occupies 75% of cell height, trunk base same level as left. It should feel nurtured and cozy, not an ancient gigantic fantasy tree.
Match materials of game art: gouache watercolor, expressive dark brown outline, sage and olive greens, dappled warm light, simplified foliage masses readable at 100px. No planter, pot, floor, grass island, robot, furniture, hanging objects, fruits, labels, text, numbers, panels, borders, watermarks or checkerboard. No surrounding environment. Pure alpha around both isolated trees.
prompts.props_atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production PROP SPRITE ATLAS for a cozy old-train gardening game. Supplied train image is material/style reference only. Square canvas, EXACTLY THREE equal columns by THREE equal rows; nine separate objects, one per cell, each fully isolated on true transparent alpha, with 12% empty padding. Fixed straight-on side-cutaway game camera, slight view down onto top surfaces. Hand-painted gouache, restrained dark brown outlines, worn sage metal, warm wood, cream highlights. Clear broad forms readable at 40-80px. No cell borders, titles, labels, text, symbols, numbers, scenery, characters, ground tiles or checkerboard.
Row1 left: ONE empty low rectangular planter box made from salvaged olive train metal with brown wooden rim; inside opening EMPTY dark recess, no soil or plants. Middle: separate flat rounded rectangular patch of rich brown potting SOIL seen at matching planter-top perspective, no rim. Right: one small worn olive upholstered train bench, simple light cream cushion, facing viewer.
Row2 left: one short stack of two weathered wooden storage crates. Middle: one small battered blue metal watering can, spout facing right. Right: one small garden trowel, warm brown handle, gray metal scoop, diagonal.
Row3 left: one hanging trailing ivy spray with 5-8 broad leaves to attach to a ceiling beam, NO pot. Middle: one small low floor moss-and-leaf clump, no ground slab. Right: one simple warm-yellow pendant lamp with short dark cable and olive shade, no ceiling.
Each prop occupies at most 75% of its own cell. Transparent everything outside the object.
prompts.icons_atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME UI AND EFFECT SPRITE ATLAS in warm hand-painted gouache style matching the supplied train reference. True transparent background, exactly FOUR columns and FIVE rows of equal square cells, 20 separate icons. Portrait 4:5 canvas. Every icon centered in its cell at consistent size, at least 18% alpha padding; thick readable dark olive outline, simple broad silhouette readable at 20-32px. Muted sage, cream, warm gold, pale cyan. No text, letters, numbers, labels, panels, badges around icons, grid lines, background or checkerboard.
Row1 resources/effect: (1) pale cyan water droplet resource, (2) amber lightning bolt energy, (3) small coiled pale plant fiber bundle, (4) ONE large clear luminous cyan dew droplet with white reflection, isolated, no leaf or base.
Row2 functions: (1) cream speech bubble with three dark dots, (2) small open cream notebook with green binding and simple line marks, (3) small leafy tree silhouette, (4) two amber fast-forward triangles.
Row3 status: (1) ripe golden flower with a small checkmark, (2) empty droplet outline to mean water shortage, (3) nearly empty small battery, (4) crossed tiny trowel and leaf for construction.
Row4 physical gestures: (1) small circular device with side shake motion lines, (2) same device upright with a horizontal leveling line beneath, (3) same device tilted counterclockwise with a curved left arrow, (4) same device tilted clockwise with a curved right arrow. Device is a plain round dark olive screen with cream rim. Clear distinct directions.
Row5 communication/particles: (1) small quiet bell with slash, (2) small bell with a bright amber notification dot, (3) one simple warm gold four-point sparkle particle, (4) one detached green leaf particle.
No extra objects, no duplicate icons, no decorative flourishes, no watermarks. All space outside icons truly transparent.
prompts.event_drought: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one small square story-event illustration for the drought journey of a cozy train gardening game. Style reference is the supplied train concept: gouache, hand-drawn dark outlines, warm muted colors, gentle post-apocalyptic nature, no threat or tragedy. Full opaque square image. Landscape view from a moving train, but NO train or window frame is visible: softly rolling dry ochre hills, pale warm sky, a few hardy sage-green shrubs, distant abandoned railway arch, a small patch of cracked earth in foreground. One fresh green shoot beside a dry stone makes mood hopeful. Broad simple shapes, focal detail centered inside middle 70% so it works at 96px. No characters, animals, buildings in foreground, skulls, fires, UI, captions, borders, symbols or typography. This is an event vignette, not an additional game biome or mechanic.
prompts.floor_platform: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE isolated old-train FLOOR PLATFORM layer for a 480x480 cozy garden train game. Supplied train image is style/material reference. A single straight horizontal strip of weathered olive metal and faded wooden floor panels, slightly viewed from above to show a walkable top surface, with a dark structural lip below. NO walls, windows, train wheels, characters, plants, pots, furniture, separate objects, shadows extending away from floor, text, labels, UI, frame or checkerboard. Intended to be placed OVER the floor baked into the shell to supply a clean foreground walking layer.
